sources.note: Excerpts of art. 258 (work to the other party's order) and art. 264 (acceptance) read. Private publisher; not cross-checked against the State Gazette.

sources.label: ZZD, arts. 20a and 63
sources.note: Amendment only by mutual consent; exact, good-faith performance.

clauses.text: This annex is an integral part of the agreement "{{parent.title}}" No. {{parent.reference}} of {{parent.date}} (the "Agreement") and is made in {{contract.place}} on {{contract.date}} under No. {{contract.reference}}.
clauses.note: Ties the annex to the agreement.

clauses.text: In case of conflict between this annex and the Agreement on technical characteristics, this annex prevails; on all other matters the Agreement prevails.
clauses.note: Precedence rule to avoid conflicts between documents.
Defines the subject of the work.

clauses.text: The Contractor delivers the following results:
The following are outside the scope:
The results are accepted when they meet the following criteria:
clauses.note: Measurable criteria; acceptance and the effect of silence are regulated in the Agreement.

clauses.text: The deadlines are: start {{terms.start_date}}, delivery by {{terms.delivery_date}}. The review period is {{terms.acceptance_days}} days and the included correction rounds are {{terms.revision_rounds}}.
clauses.note: Repeats parameters from the Agreement; on any divergence the Agreement governs the legal terms.

clauses.text: Hosting and deployment: {{terms.hosting_terms}}. Costs of hosting, domains, external services and third-party licences are borne by the Client.
clauses.note: External costs borne by the client.
Support is not included unless agreed.

clauses.text: The work depends on the Client providing materials, access and decisions on time. Third-party components and open-source software are used under their own licences.
Changes to this annex are made only by written agreement. Work outside the described scope is commissioned and priced separately before it starts.
clauses.note: Written form for changes; separate pricing of additional work.
